rules.consent_first: The first answer must be a consent phase; 'refuse' is a valid terminal state and is never scored as a failure.
rules.stop_anytime: A 'stop' phase ends the session; the reason is journaled as a hash only.
rules.energy: Every phase declares an energy cost (string or integer, never float). Spending beyond the budget is refused and ends the session.
rules.consolidation: Nothing is consolidated into persistent memory unless the answer carries agree: true.
rules.privacy: Answer contents are journaled as SHA-256 only; the capsule contains no free text.
